posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King filming continues with a massive ensemble cast including Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone. Karan Johar explained his Instagram 'digital detox' unfollowing of SRK and other celebs.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Her YRF spy thriller Alpha with Sharvari has been preponed to July 3, 2026. Alia plays an assassin in this action-heavy origin story co-starring Bobby Deol.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Sharing poolside Sunday vibes from Hyderabad where she's filming SS Rajamouli's epic Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu — marking her big Indian cinema comeback.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: The Don 3 fallout deepens as his collaboration offer to Farhan and Zoya Akhtar was turned down. FWICE issued a non-cooperation directive; Ranveer was spotted in Budapest with Arsenal's Declan Rice.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Dropped hints about her Spirit exit controversy at a Cartier event in Stockholm. Using a body double for action scenes in King and Allu Arjun's Raaka amid her second pregnancy.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali heads to OTT after its theatrical run. His Aura world tour continues to break records, including highest-ever ticket sales at Chicago's Allstate Arena.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Reportedly injured while shooting for her new film Eetha, sustaining a fracture that halted filming. Also rumored for a Kalpana Chawla biopic and praised beau Rahul Mody as 'gifted.'

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Shared son Vihaan Kaushal's first photo in a heartfelt birthday wish to Vicky Kaushal. Entering her 'padel era' with a sporty 'Never Say Never' vibe.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 promotions in full swing with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon ahead of its June 19 release. Playfully addressed the viral 'shoulder moment' clip with Shahid during a promo outing.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Entering her 'padel era' with sports content and a 'Never Say Never' attitude. Meghna Gulzar's Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran has wrapped filming.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: His mega sci-fi film Raaka with director Atlee has begun filming in Mumbai on a massive ₹600 crore budget. Deepika Padukone, Mrunal Thakur, and Janhvi Kapoor co-star.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi, his sports action drama with Janhvi Kapoor, releases June 4. Co-star Janhvi revealed he's become the 'reference point for Indians' at US airports after RRR.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Promoting Peddi with Ram Charan ahead of its June 4 release. Revealed that US immigration officers now recognize Indian actors through RRR and Ram Charan.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Filed for personality rights protection in Delhi High Court against unauthorized AI and deepfake misuse of his identity. Awaiting the release of Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Approached for Jailer 2 after Shah Rukh Khan opted out due to King scheduling. Also reportedly moving into directing and production with a social thriller project.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Her romantic film Chand Mera Dil is in theaters, collecting ₹17.25 crore net in its first week. Sister Rysa is among the star kids who graduated in 2026.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Spoke candidly about society's unfair pressure on women to be 'fit again' right after childbirth, calling out the double standard. Upcoming projects in the pipeline.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: His global fame from RRR continues to resonate — Janhvi Kapoor revealed US immigration officers still bring up his name. New projects in development after War 2.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Romantically linked with The Family Man director Raj Nidimoru after dinner date sightings. In talks to star opposite Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Among the growing list of Bollywood celebrities who've sought personality rights protection in Delhi High Court against deepfakes and unauthorized AI content.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Continues her concert tours across major cities worldwide. The legendary playback singer remains one of India's most celebrated voices with upcoming live performances.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Scoring the music for Ram Charan's Peddi releasing June 4. A birthday special celebrated his legacy of discovering debut singers who became legends — from Benny Dayal to Jonita Gandhi.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: His final film Jana Nayagan's production continues with director H. Vinoth addressing the delays. His political party TVK remains active in Tamil Nadu's political landscape.
